# Honeybeasts: You can find them in these locations and events

![Honeybeasts: You can find them in these places and events](/uploads/298_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Honeybeasts are originally normal honeybees that have undergone radiation and various mutations and have now reached the size of humans. Normal honey bees build their hives on their backs. They can no longer fly, so they move on the ground and on walls. The bees on the honey beasts' backs can also attack.

The honey beasts are also regularly needed for the daily and weekly challenges. Therefore, here you will find a summary of where honey beasts can appear.

## Locations with honey beasts

- **Northeast of Freddy Fear's Scary House** (top right) there is an unmarked spot. (This is also where you often end up at the Pathfinder Daily for flatulent fly glands.)
- You can sometimes find honey beasts at the **Seneca Rocks Visitor Center**
- You can sometimes find honey beasts in the **Whitespring Resort** between the huts or in the garden.
- Three can spawn at the **treetops**
- You can sometimes find honey beasts at the **Freakshow**

## Events with honey beasts

- **Irrational fears**
- **Project Paradise**
- **Really awesome** (at the Seneca Rocks Visitor Center)
- **Scorched Earth** (Queen)
- **Hornbush Dying**: one or two can be found on the Graninger Farm
- **Healthy and Safe**
- **The Wheel**
- (Seasonal) Six or more can spawn in the **One-A-Bites** events during Meat Week
- (Seasonal) You can sometimes find two or three at the **Fastnacht** event

See also: Fallout76 Wiki
